methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $2.0B - $3.8B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Nominal, an AI & Software company at Series B-2, commands a current valuation of $1.0B following $155M in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables spanning multiple funding stages: Ayar Labs (Series E, $3.8B), Black Forest Labs (Series B, $3.2B), and Field AI (IPO, $2.0B). The broader frontier-tech landscape includes 9 public and private comparables, anchored by Palantir (public) and private peers including Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI.

Peer-median valuation methodology, the sole triangulation method applicable to available data, yields a median implied valuation of $3.2B across the three-company peer set, with a range spanning $2.0B to $3.8B. This method leverages direct stage and sector alignment while acknowledging stage heterogeneity within the peer group—specifically the inclusion of a Series E and an IPO-stage company alongside a Series B direct comparable.

Triangulation supports a valuation range of $2.8B (low) to $3.7B (high), centered at $3.2B. This implies meaningful upside from the current $1.0B mark. Key uncertainties include the limited sample size of applicable comparables, the mixed funding stages present in the peer set, and the absence of revenue or unit-economics data to inform revenue multiple validation. Stage-appropriate precedent transactions would substantially strengthen conviction in any point estimate within this range.
